# Basemap data (vendored, offline)

Used by the traceroute web map (Leaflet) and the PDF report route map (`app/services/pdf_route_map.py`).
Neither fetches map data at runtime.

| File | Content | SHA-256 |
|------|---------|---------|
| `world-110m.geojson` | Natural Earth admin-0 countries, 1:110m, reduced to `{iso}` properties (177 countries, 170 KB) | `4f4dde9bff703123a31ce5095127f8f97021d72052999509a484b7ef9bdcf70d` |
| `labels.json` | Country and city labels, generated by `tools/build-map-labels.py` from Natural Earth 1:110m countries and 1:50m populated places | `18262862bf527052bbf93820b2c4125967d55ce7f7298fc790f4c3e46bee1dda` |

- Source: [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/) (public domain, no attribution required; the map caption credits it anyway).
- The exact Natural Earth version and download URL of `world-110m.geojson` were not recorded when it was added to the repository.
  `labels.json` comes from the `nvkelso/natural-earth-vector` GitHub mirror (see the script).
- `tests/test_pdf_route_map.py` pins both hashes and size caps. After regenerating a file, update the table and the pins.
